title: Does not mix.
text: Does not mix.. This was very awful. I had a few Oreo cookies that I tried to chop up in this Manuel food processor. It will not chop it up, so i try to chop it up some more and putting it back in the food processor...... No it just would not turn. So I chopped it up two more pieces and put it back in there which I Shouldn't have to do.I did and try to spend turn it. It barely turn. The commercial that came with this product is a false because this was horrible.

product_metadata.title: Food Chopper Manual Food Processor Hand Pull Mincer Blender Mixer for Vegetable Fruits Nuts Onions Durable BPA Free Food Safe Material (2 Cup-White & Gray)
features: 👍👍Safety Material: The Lid is made of ABS material, which is more solid. Strong nylon drawstring design for increased wear resistance and rapid rebound. The blade consists of three stainless steel blades for more efficient cutting (keep the blade in a container when not in use). The cup body is made of PS material, suitable for dishwasher safety. The bottom also adds anti-skid rubber strip design. Therefore, the material meets the standard of food safety, please rest assured to buy and use.

👍👍How to use it: For kitchen vegetables, it's a quick way to chop them up. You can make puree or other ingredients such as garlic, Onions, red cabbage, herbs, etc. Or you like to make fruit smoothies, which help you chop up the fruit quickly, of course the more you pull the fruit, the more fragmented it becomes. Avocados, apples and so on. It can even be used on nuts, such as peanuts. Cut foods can be stored in containers and stored in the refrigerator.

👍👍Save time: When you pull on the string, the blade rotates quickly to cut the dish into the shape you want. Pull it about 5 times,It's going to take about 5 seconds,It's a rough cut. 10 to 15 is a fine cut that takes 10 seconds. More than 15 times can be used for dipping. Very fast and saves time.

👍👍Operation suggestion: The blade is inlaid on the plastic handle, the blade is very sharp, try to avoid direct contact with the blade by hand. All fittings are suitable for the dishwasher, but pay special attention to LIDS with drawstrings because water can get in during dishwasher washing. Therefore, it is suggested that after washing, please pull the rope to drain the water or not into the dishwasher, directly wipe clean, so that the efficiency is higher.
